mentions.name: Polyglot web framework in 15 languages
mentions.description: A polyglot web framework implemented in 15 languages, with C# and Lean4 as the reference implementations. AI writes the code while deterministic tools audit structural and behavioral consistency of every port against the reference, correcting AI output without human code review. The codebase is about 1.8M lines.
mentions.problem: A 1-year part-time experiment testing how far AI-written code can go from 'working' to 'correct' to 'good' using deterministic audits for structure, AI-mistake correction, and behavior validation, without a human reading the code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a polyglot web framework in 15 languages, with C# and Lean4 as the reference implementations. Structural and behavioral audits using deterministic tools check that every port stays consistent with the reference. It's about 1.8M lines now.
